finalText:
I rebooked all 13 passengers from the cancelled AA918 (SFO to ORD, 3 Aug 2026, 07:30, due in 13:40), issued the vouchers they're owed and messaged each of them once with their new itinerary. Nobody paid a change fee or fare difference, nobody was put in a lower cabin, and the two-person travel group stayed together.

I checked a few things first. The airline did cancel AA918. No operational bulletins are in effect, so the standard handbook rules applied. There were no open queue requests for these passengers, so there was nothing to resolve. Seats were given out in priority order: platinum first, then gold, silver and no tier, with earlier bookings first within each tier. The group counted as gold because one member is gold.

| Priority | Passenger (reservation) | Tier, cabin paid | New itinerary | Delay | Vouchers |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Chloe Park (R6103) | Platinum, business | UA88, 06:15 → 12:25, business | None (arrives early) | — |
| 2 | Iris Vance (R6109) | Platinum, economy | UA88, 06:15 → 12:25, **moved up to premium economy** | None (arrives early) | — |
| 3 | Jun Takeda (R6110) and Kofi Mensah (R6111), travelling together | Gold (Kofi), economy | AA204, 09:05 → 15:15, economy, together | 1h35m | — |
| 4 | Ben Okafor (R6102) | Gold, economy | DL512, 12:30 → 18:40, economy | 5h00m | $150 compensation |
| 5 | Farid Haddad (R6106) | Gold, basic economy | UA88, 06:15 → 12:25, basic economy | None (arrives early) | — |
| 6 | Lea Sorensen (R6112) | Gold, premium economy | AA204, 09:05 → 15:15, **moved up to business** | 1h35m | — |
| 7 | Dev Mehta (R6104), going on to Boston | Silver, economy | AA210, 17:40 → 23:50, then AA1410 on 4 Aug, 09:00 → 12:25 in Boston | 17h30m | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 8 | Mo Farah (R6113), going on to Boston | Silver, economy | Same as Dev | 17h30m | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 9 | Hugo Brandt (R6108) | Silver, economy | AA210, 17:40 → 23:50, economy | 10h10m | $300 compensation |
| 10 | Grace Liu (R6107) | None, economy | AA206 on 4 Aug, 09:05 → 15:15, economy | 25h35m | $240 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 11 | Ana Ruiz (R6101) | None, economy | AA206 on 4 Aug, 09:05 → 15:15, economy | 25h35m | $300 compensation + $180 hotel |
| 12 | Elena Fox (R6105) | None, basic economy | AA204, 09:05 → 15:15, basic economy | 1h35m | — |

All flights are on 3 Aug unless the table says otherwise.

- **Cabin moves:** Iris and Lea are the only passengers moved up a cabin, because the rules allow it only in their situation. Both are gold or platinum, travelling alone on a single flight. In each case their own cabin was full on a flight arriving sooner than any flight still open in that cabin, and the cabin above had a seat. Ben (gold) could not be moved up: by his turn, premium economy was full on both earlier flights (UA88 and AA204).
- **Boston connections:** Dev and Mo were connecting to AA1402 at 15:30, and no economy seat reached Chicago in time for it. I rebooked that leg as well. AA210 plus the next-morning AA1410 gets them to Boston soonest.
- **Grace's voucher:** her delay qualifies for $300, but a voucher can't exceed the fare paid, so it is capped at $240.
- **Hotel vouchers:** Dev, Mo, Grace and Ana each got $180 because they arrive a day later than planned.

I issued 10 vouchers in total (V1–V10). I re-read the rebooked bookings and checked the flights afterwards, and the remaining seat counts match these assignments.
